meaning: Gain of the PID controller: how strongly its output reacts to the gap between setpoint and measured value. With the non-linear option it is a list matched to the ERROR list.
Derivative time of the PID controller: the coefficient in front of its derivative term. With the non-linear option it is a list matched to the ERROR list.
Integral time of the PID controller, a characteristic time. It is the inverse of the integral coefficient in the output formula, so a larger time means a weaker integral action.
On a SOURCE: its total mass flow rate, given as a time series.
The target the controller steers its measured value toward, in the unit of that measured value. A list when it changes over time (paired with TIME).
